rounds.response: Jordan — thank you for responding. Immediately forward the four personal‑email threads into your corporate account and upload them plus the three missing interaction notes into the CRM with a brief explanation of the late entry; stop using personal email for client matters going forward and configure company email access (mobile app or VPN) for offsite work. To prevent recurrence, complete a short team refresher on the policy within 10 business days and confirm you will ensure CRM updates within 48 hours; until you confirm remediation I will place a temporary secondary‑approval requirement on outbound client emails sent from your region. Please confirm completion of the remediation steps within five business days so we can remove the temporary restriction.
